LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Legacy: Keep saved manual diet sliders. New meals satisfy hunger immediately; fullness measures volume. Saved perks are retained.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Maintain: Eat normal meals under the assigned food policy. Body mass follows food intake and native energy use; ordinary changes are limited to 1% of the race baseline per day.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Gain: Allow spaced extra meals within a daily extra-meal allowance and comfortable fullness. Ordinary hunger still permits normal meals. Automatically return to Maintain after gaining 10% of the race baseline.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Lose: Wait longer between whole meals and draw a small, accounted contribution from body reserves. Urgent hunger always triggers eating. Stop at the target or a safe baseline. Starvation and malnutrition disable deliberate reserve use.
LanguageData.RR_BodyGoalDesc_Recovery: Use normal care priorities and a small extra meal allowance to restore the race baseline. Automatically return to Maintain at the target. The assigned food policy still applies.
